title: Show producer how each criterion is verified; record its pre-verdict
summary: Root cause: the producer's brief shows criteria but not how the verifier will check each one. A producer-reported "met" with no matching evidence (sweep criteria, line width, named tests) passes the send-back check, and the miss surfaces only at final verification. The fix gives the producer a per-criterion check hint in its brief and stores the per-criterion check on every attempt. It is a brief change, not a refusal rule. It also addresses jobs 20261014-170031-2r9b, 20261014-172342-rqgb and 20261014-174937-hrzn.

defaults_applied.how: Tests named in criteria; fmt, clippy, test recorded.
Fix placed in the brief builder, which feeds every job.
Criteria check rendered brief text and stored detail through tests that fail on the base tree.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: the goal is fewer jobs failing final verification on a criterion the producer reported met. The audience is the producer, whose brief gains the information, and the verifier and introspection reader, who see the stored check.

Code survey: crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs (send-back loop at about lines 560-715; it records the attempt's invocation detail only on failure), crates/athena-core/src/run/send_back.rs (unmet_criteria matches criteria_check entries by key and trusts a status of met; is_athena_check_criterion), crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (the producer brief and the AcceptedReading criteria), crates/athena-context/src/outputs.rs (CriterionCheckOutput) and crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md. The entry point is the producer stage's run loop. No new record or data file is added, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are untouched. The property is measured directly: the rendered producer brief text and the recorded invocation detail.

Earlier jobs: 20261014-170031-2r9b, 20261014-172342-rqgb and 20261014-174937-hrzn each changed the role prompts, the reader budget, verify.rs and docs about request-goal survival, and each was rejected on one remaining unmet criterion, a stale 1,800 mention or an over-wide line. Those causes are not repeated here. Their changed files (CHANGELOG.md, the three prompts, context lib.rs, verify.rs, decisions.md, athena-v0.md, decision-sets.md, defaults-loop.md, socratic-review.md, records.md) are dropped, except CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md, which this job appends to. Each earlier finding is covered by the new brief hint, which tells the producer to sweep the repo for 'every mention' criteria and to check line width for rewrapped prose.
No refusal rule is added, so no refused-reading share applies. The hint is information in the brief, and the send-back loop is unchanged.
Existing code: crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs are extended, and the criteria_check report field is reused as is.

acceptance_criteria.text: The change description names the root cause: the producer is shown criteria but not how each will be verified, so a reported 'met' without evidence passes until final verification. The fix is in the producer brief builder in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, recorded in a new appended decision in docs/decisions.md with a Provenance bullet and in CHANGELOG.md.

The producer brief rendered by crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs lists, for each accepted criterion, how the verifier checks it: a named file or diff line for a content criterion, and a command that ran for a behavior one. A criterion that says every mention, or no longer appears, gets a repo-wide search with zero remaining hits. A rewrapped-prose criterion gets a line-width check. No new check refuses or holds work.

A new unit test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs fails on the base tree and passes with the change. It renders the brief for a reading with a sweep criterion and a behavior criterion, and asserts that each hint appears. Run `cargo test -p athena-context`.

A new test in crates/athena-core/src/run/ drives the producer stage with the fake agent and shows that the attempt's stored invocation detail carries the per-criterion check, status and evidence on a passing attempt, not only on failure. It fails on the base tree. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
The recorded fmt, clippy and test checks on the final tree pass: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets`, `cargo test`.
The changed prompt files stay within their token budgets, with the budgets test in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs passing, and no budget is raised.

out_of_scope: Adding a repair loop after the verifier or changing the job lifecycle
Adding any refusal or hold rule
Editing reader, verifier or contract prompts, or any budget
Reverting or redoing the docs and budget edits of jobs 20261014-170031-2r9b, 20261014-172342-rqgb and 20261014-174937-hrzn
Edits to records/ or owner files
departures: Slightly higher cost: a change to the shared brief builder and the run loop, with a hard-job review.
urgent_reason: It cuts failed and rejected attempts: the same unmet-criterion failure recurred in 43 jobs.
hard_reason: It changes the run pipeline, namely how the producer is briefed and how each attempt is recorded, so a mistake is costly and hard to see.
